reason: A answers my two standing objections: it says chains are over 20 miles away in 14 counties and that two pharmacies will stop filling for my members, and it offers invoices I can verify, admits the brand-drug offset and what it doesn't know about closures, and gives a May 1 meeting window. B is unfinished with placeholders, implies the nine closures were rate-driven, overstates the loss as "a fifth of its work," and reads like the usual annual complaint.
